{{Quote|I&hellip; have orchestrated all of this. I have built this for us all. We will realize our destiny&mdash;as one.''"<br />"''I don't think they feel your role is as central as you do. You're just another Sith flunkie&mdash;just another tool.|Saaj Calician and Kerra Holt, discussing Calician's importance to the plans of the Sith Lords Dromika and Quillan|<ref name="Knight Errant novel" />}}
'''Saaj Calician''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Krevaaki]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who lived during the [[Republic Dark Age]]. Calician originally served the [[Chagras Hegemony]], a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] state in the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]] that was led by the powerful Sith [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Chagras]], and following Chagras' [[Death/Legends|death]] in [[1040 BBY]], the Krevaaki was appointed as the guardian to Chagras' [[Twin/Legends|twin]] [[Youngling/Legends|children]], [[Dromika]] and [[Quillan (Sith)|Quillan]]. In that role, Calician became the [[Regent/Legends|regent]] of the [[Dyarchy]], a Sith principality based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Byllura]] that the twins headed, and over the next few [[Standard year/Legends|years]], Calician set about strengthening their territories. The twins never left [[The Loft|their quarters]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Hestobyll]] on Byllura and they comprehended the outside world entirely through their connection to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], with Calician serving as their primary link to the wider [[Universe/Legends|universe]]. Yet as they aged, the twins increasingly began to use Dromika's [[Mind trick/Legends|Force persuasion]] [[Force power/Legends|abilities]] to take direct control of Calician's [[Brain/Legends|mind]], turning him into an unthinking extension of their will.

By [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], the Dyarchy had grown strong enough to challenge its neighbors, and Calician planned to launch a [[Dyarchy Fleet|fleet]] of [[Battleship/Legends|battleships]] to conquer worlds in the rival [[Daimanate]] territory. After a [[Diligence (New Sith Wars)|mercenary transport]] from the Daimanate landed on Byllura, Calician viewed it as a sign that the Daimanate's borders were unguarded, because the Daimanites would not willingly have allowed a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] to leave their domain, and he ordered his [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] to mobilize. However, the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kerra Holt]], a passenger aboard the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] vessel, infiltrated Hestobyll and disrupted the Dyrachy's [[Celegian/Legends|Celegian]]-based communications network. Calician [[Battle of Byllura|confronted]] and [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|dueled]] her, but was unable to defeat the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], so he stood down and offered to introduce her to Dromika and Quillan. However, when he showed her to the twins, Dromika attempted to use the Force to compel Calician to strike down the Jedi, and he resisted, because he wanted to fight Holt by himself. In the ensuing chaos, Holt kidnapped Quillan and fled Byllura with him aboard the mercenary [[Transport/Legends|transport]]. Shortly afterward, forces loyal to the twins' elder sister [[Arkadia Calimondra]] landed on Byllura and had Calician executed.

==Biography==
===Forging the Dyarchy===
{{Quote|I've never been back this far. But they say there is a Sith principality that's run by children.''"<br />"''Children?''"<br />"''Well, I don't know much about it. I always imagined it was some kind of regency deal, with the power behind the crèche and all that.|Jarrow Rusher and Kerra Holt, on the nature of the power structure in the Dyarchy|<ref name="Knight Errant novel" />}}
Saaj Calician was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Krevaaki]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Knight Errant novel" /> who lived during the [[Republic Dark Age]].<ref name="Dark Age">The ''Knight Errant'' novel is set in [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], and ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' identifies this [[Time/Legends|timeframe]] as being part of the [[Republic Dark Age]].</ref> As a [[Youngling/Legends|child]], Calician was taunted by other Krevaaki who were jealous of his intelligence, and they referred to him as "[[Celegian/Legends|Celegian]]," after a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Invertebrate/Legends|invertebrates]] that resembled floating [[Brain/Legends|brains]]. In his youth, Calician learned to utilize the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]], and he studied the ways of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] in the service of the [[Chagras Hegemony]], a state established by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Chagras]] in the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]]. During the course of his [[Sith training]], Calician fought numerous [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]], [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-wielding enemies of the Sith, and had his first encounter with real Celegians after visiting a colony on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tramanos]]. He eventually became a Sith [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] and, at some point, authored [[Saaj Calician's writings|some writings]] on how the peak of Sith power could be attained.<ref name="Knight Errant novel" />

At around [[1041 BBY]], Calician became acquainted with Chagras' five-[[Standard year/Legends|year]]-old [[Twin/Legends|twin]] children Dromika and Quillan, and the Krevaaki realized that through them, he could attain great power for himself. Quillan had a greater ability to [[Farsight/Legends|predict the future]] than any other Sith whom Calician had met, while Dromika was more proficient with the use of the Force to [[Mind trick/Legends|control minds]] than anyone else he knew, and he hoped to harness their [[Force power/Legends|powers]] to serve his own ends. Following the [[Death/Legends|death]] of Chagras in [[1040 BBY]], Calician became the custodian of the twins, and they established the [[Dyarchy]], a Sith principality based on the planet [[Byllura]], with Calician as their [[Regent/Legends|regent]]. The twins never left [[The Loft]], their private residence in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Hestobyll]], and perceived the wider [[Universe/Legends|universe]] entirely through the Force, referring to individuals and objects external to themselves as "aspects." The twins regarded Calician himself as their "regent-aspect," and he served as their main link to the outside world. He tended to their every need and acquired some [[Nanny droid/Legends|nanny droids]] to care for the twins when he wasn't present. Chagras' demise left the twins' grandmother [[Vilia Calimondra]] without an heir to her [[Vilia Calimondra's empire|extensive holdings]], and she initiated a [[Second Charge Matrica|competition]] among her grandchildren to find a worthy successor, which soon degenerated into an all-out conflict between her descendants. The Dyarchy was pitted against competing Sith states, and Calician planned to strengthen the twins' empire, to make it powerful enough to wage war against their rivals.<ref name="Knight Errant novel" />

Inspired by watching the [[Telepathy/Legends|telepathic]] communications between [[jornisae spider]]s on his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] as a child, Calician became determined to establish a telepathic transmission network on Byllura, to place himself and the twins in full control of the Dyarchy's inhabitants. Within a few [[Standard day/Legends|days]] of his appointment as the twins' guardian, Calician captured a 200-year-old Force-sensitive Celegian, which he named [[One (Celegian)|One]], and brought him back to The Loft. There, he [[Torture/Legends|tortured]] One and broke the Celgian's mind, bypassing his judgment centers to make him into a mindless servant with no capacity for independent thought. With his endeavors successful, Calician lured entire Celegian communities into settling on Byllura and used their telepathic capabilities to form a communication web. A force of [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith adepts]], known as [[Unifier]]s, were installed to use the Force to dull the minds of the Dyarchy's inhabitants and send messages to the web, and through One, Calician could coordinate Hestobyll's defenses and send out orders across the entire Bylluran communication network.<ref name="Knight Errant novel" />

Over the next few years, the Dyarchy's population, manufacturing facilities, and military capabilities expanded under Calician's guidance. However, as the twins aged, they increasingly began to use Dromika's mental capabilities to take direct control of Calician's mind; he often found himself subsumed into the communications web that he had created, becoming an unthinking extension of the twins' will. In [[1037 BBY]], he initiated construction of the [[Dyarchy Fleet]], a [[Fleet/Legends|force]] of [[Battleship/Legends|battleships]] that were to be built in secret beneath [[Hestobyll reflecting pools|Hestobyll's reflecting pools]]. Around that [[Time/Legends|time]], he also spoke with [[Daiman]], the twins' cousin and the leader of the neighboring [[Daimanate]] Sith state, via [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] on a number of occasions, and he found Daiman unwilling to either ally with or engage in hostilities against the Dyarchy.<ref name="Knight Errant novel" />

===Downfall===
{{Quote|You will destroy the Jedi! ''You will destroy the Jedi!"<br />"''Yes&mdash;''I'' will destroy the Jedi. Not you! ''Me!'' Release me! ''You will release me!''<nowiki></nowiki>|Dromika and Saaj Calician, as Calician protests that he be permitted to fight Kerra Holt by himself, and not under Dromika's Force influence|<ref name="Knight Errant novel" />}}
By [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], fourteen [[Starship/Legends|vessels]] in the Dyarchy Fleet had been completed, and Calician made plans to expand the Dyarchy's holdings. Elsewhere in the Grumani [[Sector/Legends|sector]], Daiman committed the bulk of his military to the [[Invasion of the Bactranate|invasion]] of the [[Bactranate]], a territory led by Lord [[Ayanos Bactra]], which Vilia Calimondra had ordered her grandchildren to annex. The outlying Daimanite worlds on the border with the Dyarchy were left unguarded, and Calician believed that once launched, the firepower of his fleet would deter any Daimanite resistance, allowing the Dyarchy to conquer entire worlds without a single shot being fired. Amid the chaos, the [[Troop transport/Legends|troop transport]] [[Diligence (New Sith Wars)|''Diligence'']], operated by the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] unit [[Rusher's Brigade]], rescued a large number of [[Refugee/Legends|refugee]] children and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Knight [[Kerra Holt]] from a [[Battle of Gazzari|battlefield]] on the Daimanite-held world [[Gazzari]] and headed toward Byllura, where the mercenaries hoped to rid themselves of their passengers. Quillan and Dromika [[Force sense/Legends|sensed]] the vessel's approach through the Force and summoned Calician to them to order him to contact Byllura's defensive stations and inform the twins of any reports of foreign vessels in the vicinity of the world. A short time later, ''Diligence'' arrived in the [[Bylluran system|system]], and Calician permitted the vessel to land and allowed its occupants to disembark. He was excited by the ship's arrival, viewing it as an omen that the time was right to strike against Daiman, because the Daimanite forces would not have permitted a ship to leave their domain if they had sufficient military forces in the vicinity of their border.<ref name="Knight Errant novel" />

[[File:Holt_vs_Calician.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Saaj Calician and Kerra Holt, dueling in One's chamber]]
With backing from Dromika and Quillan, Calician ordered the Dyarchy Fleet to launch. However, Holt became suspicious of the Dyarchy's intentions and ordered the refugees to re-board ''Diligence''. Calician was concerned by their embarkation and feared that it could be part of a Daimanite trap, but before he could take further action, he was summoned by the twins back to The Loft. Holt left to investigate the city, and through his telepathic network, Calician was informed of the Jedi's approach. The twins viewed Holt as a threat and ordered the Krevaaki to protect them, then took direct control of his mind via the Force. Holt infiltrated The Loft and made her way to chamber in which One was being held, where she persuaded the aged Celegian to stop sending messages on behalf of the Dyarchy, placing the communications network into disarray. Under the influence of the twins, Calician headed to One's chamber and [[Battle of Byllura|attacked]] Holt with six [[lightsaber-baton]]s, which he twirled from his [[Limb/Legends|tentacles]]. He [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|threw himself]] at her in a nihilistic fury, driven by the influence of the twins, and came close to rupturing One's tank, which would have released a [[Cyanogen|poisonous gas]] and killed both him and Holt. He regained some control over his body, but Holt was able to outwit him and singe his facial tentacles, then slice off one of his limbs from his middle carapace. He felt no pain, due to the influence of the twins, and realized that Holt was too strong for him to defeat, because his withered mind could not access his memories of how to fight Jedi while it was being dulled by Dromika's mental manipulations. He therefore stopped fighting and offered to take Holt to the twins, and she accepted his proposal.<ref name="Knight Errant novel" />

Upon their arrival in the twins' quarters, several nanny [[Droid/Legends|droids]] hurled themselves at Calician and Holt in an attempt to defend the twins. However, Holt swept them away, and Calician introduced her to the twins. Using the Force, Dromika [[Telekinesis/Legends|pinned Holt down]] and compelled Calician to bring his blade to bear against the Jedi. Calician resisted, because he wanted to be given the chance to fight Holt by himself, free of the twins' mental influences. While he and Dromika were briefly distracted, Holt broke free and severed one of Calician's leg tentacles. Before he could get back on his feet, Holt kidnapped Quillan and fled Byllura with him aboard ''Diligence''. Meanwhile, the other Celegians on Byllura followed One's example and refused to send telepathic messages, leading to a breakdown of the entire telepathic network. Their rebellion made it impossible to coordinate the Dyarchy's manufacturing efforts and led to explosions in all of the world's major construction facilities, destroying the bulk of the Dyarchy Fleet. Calician quickly rushed to The Loft's communications center and sent a transmission to ''Diligence'', to learn if Quillan was still alive. Shortly afterward, the forces of the twins' elder sibling, [[Arkadia Calimondra]], initiated an attack on Byllura and defeated the remaining Dyarchy forces. [[Arkadianate|Arkadianite]] forces found Calician and executed him; according to a report received by the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] [[Narsk Ka'hane]], Calician met his end quietly. Byllura fell and the Dyarchy was subsumed into Arkadia's territories, and guardianship of the twins ultimately passed to Vilia Calimondra.<ref name="Knight Errant novel" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|My name is Saaj Celegian. I mean, Saaj ''Calician''. I know that now.|Saaj Calician, to Kerra Holt|<ref name="Knight Errant novel" />}}
As a child, Saaj Calician enjoyed performing acts of violence and was willing to blind jornisae [[Spider/Legends|spiders]] that he encountered on his homeworld. From an early age, he developed a hatred for Celegians after being taunted by other Krevaaki, and he came to dislike the telepathic beings even more after he first encountered them in the flesh. He found them repulsive and believed that they ignored their own ugliness, yet expected others not to acknowledge it. He also thought that the Celegians were fools for not using their innate telepathic abilities to gain power and influence over others. He was intelligent and, during his younger years, cared primarily about his ego; he would ponder upon the outcome of the [[New Sith Wars|conflict]] between the Sith and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and also compared himself to other Krevaaki, seeing himself as their superior because he was more powerful and independent than most members of his species. In addition, he was a believer in the ancient Sith precept of self-glorification and considered that the subjugation of others could only lead to one solution: for just one Sith to rule [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], with their subordinates merely acting as self-regulating components of the wider consciousness of their leader.<ref name="Knight Errant novel" />

While Calician originally began caring for the twins merely as a means of propelling himself into greater power to achieve his dream, he found his mind dominated by them and sacrificed his personal ambitions to become a loyal servant, unquestionably obeying all of their commands. However, his encounter with Kerra Holt led Calician to realize that, to the twins, he was merely a mindless puppet, so he rebelled against Dromika's attempts to use him to kill the Jedi. The rigors of his life on Byllura caused him to age prematurely, although whenever he acted upon Dromika's Force-influenced commands, her presence restored his youthful vigor to him. While serving as regent, Calician wore beige-[[Color/Legends|colored]] [[Robe/Legends|robes]], so as to match the walls of The Loft and thereby avoid overwhelming Quillan's visual stimuli. Calician had black [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]<ref name="Knight Errant novel" /> and a red, [[Chitin/Legends|chitinous]] [[Exoskeleton|carapace]].<ref name="Reader's Companion" />

==Powers and abilities==
Saaj Calician was an experienced fighter, but Dromika's Force influence dulled his memories of some of his combat skills. His preferred weapons were a set of lightsaber-batons, miniaturized versions of the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] weapon. However, when he [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|dueled]] with Kerra Holt on Byllura, Dromika used her powers to augment his fighting capabilities and enabled him to access abilities that he had never trained to use. He also knew how to utilize the Force to move objects, although by 1,032 BBY it had been more than a [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]] since he had used the power.<ref name="Knight Errant novel" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|In Calician, I had the chance to take a typical egomaniacal Sith and crush his will under a multi-ton weight; he's been a puppet for so long he no longer recognizes his limbs as his own.|John Jackson Miller, on Saaj Calician|<ref name="Calician Faraway Press">{{Faraway|url=fiction/starwarsknighterrantnovel|text=Star Wars: Knight Errant (novel)}}</ref>}}
Saaj Calician made his first appearance in ''[[Star Wars]]'' in [[Knight Errant (novel)|''Knight Errant'']], a novel written by [[John Jackson Miller]] that was published in [[January]] [[2011]] as a tie-in to the [[Star Wars: Knight Errant (comic series)|''Star Wars: Knight Errant'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series. In the novel, Calician is one of the four main point-of-view characters, with the others being the Bothan spy Narsk Ka'hane, the Jedi protagonist Kerra Holt, and the mercenary [[Jarrow Rusher]].<ref name="Knight Errant novel" /> Calician was later featured in the [[2012]] guide book ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'', in which he received his first visual depiction, a picture by artist [[Jeffery Carlisle|Jeff Carlisle]].<ref name="Reader's Companion" />

On his personal website Faraway Press, Miller described Calician as playing the role of a typically egomaniacal Sith who would provide the author with an opportunity to frustrate Sith ambitions. Calician also provided readers with an insider perspective of life within the Dyarchy, especially its hallmark of living under constant Force manipulation.<ref name="Faraway-Star Wars: Knight Errant – Deluge #2">{{Faraway|url=comics/swknighterrantdeluge/swknighterrantdeluge2.html|text=Star Wars: Knight Errant &ndash; Deluge #2}}</ref>
